name: ponder-chat
description: Ponder Chat: a chat app on OpenRouter models, with a daily credit limit per person.

scripts.build: PONDER_PAGE=chat vite build && PONDER_PAGE=admin vite build && tsx scripts/compress-web.ts && nitro build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/vue-tsc.cjs --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/vue-tsc.cjs --noEmit -p tsconfig.no-node.json
scripts.typecheck:server: node node_modules/frappe-ui/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --strict --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions server/app.ts server/plugins/startup.ts server/plugins/tracing.ts server/tracing/flow-middleware.ts server/pdf-text-worker.ts server/runtime/main.ts server/config.test.ts server/runtime/boundaries.test.ts server/runtime/Database.test.ts server/threads/Threads.test.ts server/secrets/Secrets.test.ts server/settings/Settings.test.ts server/net/NetGuard.test.ts server/openrouter/OpenRouter.test.ts server/models/Models.test.ts server/notify/Notify.test.ts server/telemetry/ModelCalls.test.ts server/telemetry/run-recorder.test.ts server/mcp.check.ts scripts/credits.ts
scripts.typecheck:e2e: node node_modules/frappe-ui/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2023 --strict --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --types node playwright.config.ts e2e/*.ts e2e/fake/*.ts e2e/mcp/*.ts e2e/tests/*.ts
scripts.build:web: PONDER_PAGE=chat vite build && PONDER_PAGE=admin vite build && tsx scripts/compress-web.ts
